serverInfo.name: tipitakapali-mcp-server
serverInfo.title: Tipitaka Pali Canon, Bold Definitions & DPD MCP Server
serverInfo.description: MCP server exposing Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana Tipiṭaka Pāḷi Canon books, 387K+ canonical bold definitions, multi-concept boolean search, sentence-level Pāḷi/translation alignment, and Digital Pāḷi Dictionary (DPD) lookups.

tools.name: get_bold_definitions
tools.description: Query 387,000+ pre-indexed canonical & commentarial bold definitions (Aṭṭhakathā, Ṭīkā, Visuddhimagga, Mūla) with aligned translations and verifiable [book:cX:pY-LZ] citations.

word.description: Pāḷi term to define (IAST, Velthuis, or Asian script, e.g. mettā, sati, anatta)

tools.name: search_concepts
tools.description: Multi-concept boolean intersection search across Pāḷi and translation FTS5 indexes (AND across concept groups, OR within each group's Pāḷi and English synonyms).

concept_groups.description: 2–4 concept groups, each with concept label, pali_terms, pali_stems, and english_keywords

tools.name: pali_dict_lookup
tools.description: Look up Pāḷi words in the Digital Pāḷi Dictionary (DPD), canonical bold definitions, and classical lexicons

word.description: Pāḷi word in Roman script (IAST or Velthuis, e.g. metta or mettā)

dict.description: Dictionary to query (dpd for Digital Pali Dictionary, bold_def for 387K+ canonical bold definitions, others for PTS/Burmese/Sinhala)

tools.name: pali_canon_search
tools.description: Search the entire 520,000+ paragraph Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana Tipiṭaka Pāḷi Canon and 23 translation indexes

query.description: Search phrase or term in Pāḷi or a translation language (e.g. anicca, dukkha, anatta)

l.description: Language index (pali or any translation code e.g. en, vi, my, th)

tools.name: get_canonical_text
tools.description: Retrieve Pāḷi canon book chapter content by book code and chapter number

tools.name: get_sentences
tools.description: Sentence-level Pāḷi and aligned translations with shared line_id (99.7% match). Use for precise citations [book:cX:pY-LZ].
